scope_limitations: Generic synthetic benchmark; no ecological, hydrological, growth, mortality, wind or water process is modelled.
Root edge weights are UNIFORM over the cells a root circle positively overlaps (sum to 1 per plant). They are NOT area weighted and encode no scientific allocation law.
Vertical layer weights are factorized as a uniform 1/L per layer (separability assumption); no dense plant-by-layer-by-cell tensor is formed.
The layered reduction scatters a synthetic unit demand per plant; it measures graph traversal and atomic contention, not water competition.

Canopy cover is an 8x8 midpoint sample per cell capped at 1; it is coverage only, not an exact circle union and not area conserving. Small circles can be missed entirely (aliasing); missed plants are counted and reported.
Domain is finite, rectangular, non-periodic with square cells; circles are clipped at the boundary and root weights renormalize over retained cells.
Plant positions (uniform or clumped) are synthetic seeded samples, not an ecological spatial pattern.
CPU compiled loops are single-threaded; GPU atomics are order-nondeterministic, so CPU/GPU agreement is checked with tolerances, never bitwise.
ru_maxrss is a cumulative process peak; CuPy pool numbers are sampled at stage boundaries and are not a true allocation peak.
